newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to cut some domestic energy prices - premier.
newsitem.headline: Russia to cut some domestic energy prices - premier.

text.p: A presidential decree lowering some energy prices and freezing others could be signed as early as Tuesday, Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin told the upper house of parliament.

Chernomyrdin gave no reasons for the move, which he said would affect prices for gas and electricity. Some ministers and industrialists have called for lower prices to help ailing industrial enterprises compete with companies abroad.
"A presidential decree is being prepared -- I think it could be signed today -- which envisages freezing some prices on energy and lowering others," Chernomyrdin said.
The new price structure could take effect as early as October 10, he said. Prices would be at least 10-15 percent lower than at the start of August.

The whole energy sector has been plagued by non-payments. Customers do not pay for energy they consume and the energy companies do not pay their workers. Energy workers went on strike in the Far East to complain about unpaid bills.
